evidence: Wallet label and changes to coin selection logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp and wallet functional tests.
rationale: Fixes a coin selection bug where wallets with `-avoidpartialspends` or `avoid_reuse` can fail with false 'insufficient funds' errors. Discarded groups were added twice, causing their value to be subtracted twice in `AutomaticCoinSelection` even when confirmed funds were sufficient to cover the transaction.
